content: Unit tests verify small units of behavior in isolation and provide fast feedback on regressions.
interview_relevance: Explain what should and should not be mocked.

content: Integration tests verify that multiple components or services work correctly together.
End-to-end tests exercise realistic user flows across major application layers.
The test pyramid encourages a larger base of fast unit tests, fewer integration tests, and a smaller number of slower end-to-end tests.
Mocking replaces a dependency with controlled behavior during a test so a specific unit can be tested predictably.
interview_relevance: Avoid mocking the behavior you actually need to verify.

content: Regression testing checks that existing behavior still works after changes.
